plan.goal: Autonomously explore and critique the UX of the Notion clone, validating the marketing funnel from landing to product sub-pages, templates, and pricing.
plan.summary: The exploration will start on the homepage to assess the core value proposition and navigation. It will then traverse the product sub-pages (Projects, Wikis) and the Templates directory, ensuring interactive elements like category filters or accordions work. Finally, it will rigorously test the Pricing page's interactive toggles and FAQs, followed by a dedicated mobile pass to verify layout and the flagged small tap targets.
assumptions: The header navigation is consistent across all pages.
The FAQ sections on Pricing and Templates pages use interactive accordions (buttons) that reveal hidden text.
The Pricing page contains a functional Monthly/Yearly toggle that updates price displays.
risk_hotspots: Global navigation links (flagged for small tap targets)
FAQ accordion buttons on pricing.html and templates-projects.html
Multi-column grids on mobile (pricing tiers, template listings)

phases.title: Homepage & Global Navigation
phases.objective: Validate the primary landing page messaging, CTAs, and verify global navigation connectivity.
key_checks: Check hero section CTAs ('Request a demo', 'Get Notion free')
Scroll through feature highlights and customer stories
Click top navigation links to verify routing to sub-pages
exit_criteria: All main navigation links successfully route to their respective pages
Homepage scrolled and major sections observed

phases.title: Product Discovery (Projects & Wikis)
phases.objective: Explore the specific marketing copy and layout for the core product offerings.
key_checks: Observe feature grids and descriptive blocks
Verify internal cross-linking (e.g., links from Projects to Wikis)
exit_criteria: Both projects.html and wikis.html have been visited and scrolled completely

phases.title: Templates & FAQs
phases.objective: Verify the templates layout and interact with the FAQ section.
key_checks: Observe the categorization of templates (Roadmaps, Issue Tracking, etc.)
Click on FAQ buttons (e.g., 'Is Notion good for project management?') to verify accordion expansion
exit_criteria: Templates page visited, and at least two FAQ accordions have been toggled

phases.title: Pricing & Conversion
phases.objective: Thoroughly test the pricing page interactive elements and plan descriptions.
key_checks: Toggle the Monthly/Yearly pricing switch and observe if prices change
Review the plan tiers (Free, Plus, Business, Enterprise)
Click on Pricing FAQ buttons (e.g., 'What is a block?')
exit_criteria: Pricing toggle interacted with and state change verified

phases.title: Mobile Responsiveness & Tap Targets
phases.objective: Switch to mobile viewport to check layout degradation and flagged tap targets.
key_checks: Check global navigation accessibility on mobile (hamburger menu presence/function)
Verify pricing table readability on narrow screens
Assess ease of clicking previously flagged small tap targets (e.g., top nav links)
exit_criteria: Mobile view navigated successfully and UI stacking observed on key pages

coverage_targets.pages: Visit all 5 HTML files (index, projects, wikis, templates-projects, pricing)
coverage_targets.features: Exercise Pricing toggle, Templates FAQs, and Pricing FAQs
coverage_targets.mobile: Test global nav, pricing tiers, and FAQ accordions on mobile viewport

notes: Pay special attention to the layout warnings regarding small tap targets (<44px) on links, especially when evaluating the mobile viewport.
